note: Burned-in captions, no voiceover. Cue times are seconds from the start of their act; acts[].start is absolute. Every payment in this film is SIMULATED (local test facilitator, no funds moved). Words banned for the simulated variant by docs/launch/DEMO_VIDEO.md (on-chain, settled, live, real payment, transaction link, explorer, mainnet, revenue earned) are not used.

cues.text: One YAML file configures the whole demo.
Solana devnet USDC, paid to your own pay_to. Here the facilitator is SIMULATED.
GET /api/quote costs an agent $0.002. Everything under /* stays free.
MCP tools carry their own prices: search_docs $0.005, generate_report $0.05.
One command starts origin, gateway and the SIMULATED facilitator, ledger empty.
A person opens the site through the gateway: the normal page, free.
Same gateway, /api/quote: the browser gets the JSON, with paid: false.
Claude-User asks for the same URL and gets 402 Payment Required.
The PAYMENT-REQUIRED header decodes to an x402 v2 quote: 2000 atomic USDC, $0.002.
Network, asset and payTo: everything an agent needs to pay.
Agents can read every price first: /.well-known/agenttoll.json is free.
Routes, MCP tools and networks, generated from the same YAML file.
The buyer CLI asks, gets the 402, signs a devnet USDC transfer and retries.
200 OK. The receipt comes back in the PAYMENT-RESPONSE header.
The dashboard gets the row: +$0.002, AgentToll-Buyer, Solana devnet, Simulated.
Same id on both sides: SIMULATED-…121d. No funds moved.
Claude gets a wallet through pay-mcp. First it reads the price.
$0.002 is under both caps, so Claude pays. The receipt says simulated.
Next, a $0.05 tool. Claude is told it may spend up to 10 cents.
The wallet refuses before signing: $0.05 is above the $0.01 per-call cap.
Nothing was signed and nothing counted. Claude did not work around it.
On the film stack the wallet gives the same refusal, word for word.
MCP servers sell per tool. tools/list stays free and carries every price.
An unpaid tools/call gets the MCP-native challenge: isError plus a quote, 5000 = $0.005.
Paid through pay-mcp, the tool gets its own dashboard row: mcp search_docs.
Recorded from the running dashboard: the buyer CLI pays every 2 s, rows land.
Each simulated payment updates the totals and the feed as it arrives.
After 19 payments: $0.034, and the card says it outright: all of it simulated.
By network: 100% Solana devnet. Base Sepolia, the backup rail, is not set up here.
The feed: 19 of 19 simulated. No transaction exists, so there is nothing to link.
Agent traffic you are not billing yet: crawlers on free pages, by name.
Cash out: spendable $0.00, because every payment was simulated.
Funds go to your own pay_to. AgentToll holds nothing.
The same dashboard on a phone.
The same core compiles to WebAssembly and runs as a Cloudflare Worker.
21 parity tests check byte-identical quotes against the Rust gateway.
In the repo: 119 of 119 evals, 93 Rust tests, 69 pay-mcp tests, 70 Worker tests.
Wired to the real PayAI and x402.org facilitators.
Both rejected our unfunded wallets, as expected. Settlement waits on funding.
